meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Basic Statistical Return 2 (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: BSR-2 stocks are final on release for the year; the sector classification changed in 2018-19 and the deposit-size bands in March 2026 (both disclosed, never spliced).
meta.coverage: Term deposits by interest rate, individuals and others, quarterly (scheduled commercial banks excluding regional rural banks). Amounts in ₹ crore; accounts, offices and employees as counts.
meta.note: RBI BSR-2 Table 3.5 (quarterly) via DBIE report 1321, read from the Data Bank mirror. Column meanings are fixed by identities checked on every row (scripts/lib/products/bsr2-tables.mjs). The quarterly return leaves out regional rural banks, so it is a different total from the annual return; never joined to it.
